title: The Dragon Bard
text: A bard who sings only of dragons sits on a scorched rock, his lute strung with something that glitters. He knows every dragon by name and has outlived the songs of a dozen heroes. He wants to hear your story, so he can decide how it ends.

options.label: The best talker tells him your story, and hopes he gives it a kind ending.

outcomes.text: He makes a good song of it, with dragons in it. Your House will be famous, though he has already decided how it ends.

options.label: Ask him which dragon rules here, and what she cannot abide.

outcomes.text: He tells you her name, her temper and her one weakness. Then he plays a sad chord for all who learned it before you.

options.label: Pass him by. Bards who sing of dragons rarely live long, and neither do their heroes.

outcomes.text: He sings of you anyway, badly, and the song travels home ahead of you. People hum it at the Leader's House.
He sings of you anyway, loudly enough that something living in these hills hears it.
